label: Printful
description: 1. In Printful, add a Manual order platform / API store and design your products in it. 2. Open Settings → Developers and create a private token with access to that store only (not your whole account), with the 'orders' and 'sync_products' scopes. 3. Paste it below and save, then choose Actions → Sync products now. Your products arrive in Swell as drafts to review, and an hourly sync keeps them up to date. 4. Enable the carrier in Settings → Shipping → Printful, then click Save changes — rates do not dispatch until you do. 5. Leave Live fulfillment off until you have inspected a draft order in the Printful dashboard.

actions.label: Sync products now
actions.hint: Syncs all your Printful products in the background instead of waiting for the hourly sync.

fields.label: Printful API token
fields.description: Private token from Printful Settings → Developers with access to your Manual order platform / API store only; account-wide tokens are not supported. Needs the 'orders' and 'sync_products' scopes. Use a separate token for your test environment.

fields.label: Live fulfillment
fields.description: When off, paid orders are submitted to Printful as drafts and never confirmed, so nothing is printed or charged. Turn this on only after a draft order looks correct in the Printful dashboard.

fields.label: Fallback shipping rate
fields.description: Flat rate offered when Printful is slow, rate-limited or unreachable. Leave empty to offer no Printful service at all when the quote fails.

fields.label: Fallback service name
fields.description: Name shown at checkout for the fallback rate.

fields.label: Quote cache lifetime
fields.description: How long a shipping quote is reused for the same destination and cart. Printful allows 120 requests per minute across the whole app, so caching is what keeps checkout inside that budget. Set 0 to disable.

fields.label: Rate request timeout
fields.description: How long to wait for a Printful quote before falling back. The whole function is killed at 10000ms, so keep this below 9000.

fields.label: Last product sync
fields.description: When the app last read your Printful products. It runs every hour, and whenever you choose Sync now.

fields.label: Last sync result
fields.description: What the last sync did, and any errors — for example a token without the 'sync_products' scope.

fields.label: Sync now
fields.hint: Syncs all your Printful products in the background instead of waiting for the hourly sync.
